about_the_game: The Dark Deity Original Soundtrack features over an hour of orchestral music from Composers Sam Huss and Andy Han, with a bonus piece from Adam Schmieder. Relive the highs and lows of Dark Deity's story through all the tracks from the game, mastered for standalone listening.
